messages:
Olivia Chan: Finance spotted ~11% mismatch between ACME marketplace reported units and our ledger for 2026-03-18 invoice day. Can partnerships + eng triage?
Samir Patel: On it. Which source batch?
Olivia Chan: ACME batch_id=batch-20260318-2345, they reported ~1.12M units, our system shows ~995k.
Maria Gomez: Grabbing raw webhooks from s3://partners/acme/inbound/2026-03-18.
usage-ingest-bot: ingest-processor v2.4 processed partner queue 2026-03-18T22:50Z.
Samir Patel: Quick checks: seq continuity, dedupe keys, timezone partitioning.
Maria Gomez: Found ~14k events assigned to 03-19 partition due to PST->UTC rounding; accounts for ~1.2%. Also saw partner metadata change for SKU acme.compute.small at ~20:02 PST (seconds->minutes) but that SKU is <1% of volume.
Ryan Billing: Finance also noted we applied credits; could negative adjustments be included incorrectly?
Samir Patel: Excluding adjustment rows reduces gap by ~3.8%.
Olivia Chan: Remaining ~6% unexplained. Partners-team, ask ACME if they sampled or extrapolated aggregates during peak.
partners-team: ACME reply: they ran a late resample/extrapolation starting 03-18T20:00 PST and rotated event_id generator near 23:50. Raw logs link provided.
Samir Patel: Action: 1) Short-term replay raw webhooks with current metadata + robust dedupe to produce corrected counts (owners: Maria & Samir). 2) Medium-term: require partners to include sampling_flag + raw_event_count when they extrapolate (owner: partnerships/legal).
Maria Gomez: Starting staging replay job (replay-489123-1). ETA ~3h. Will upload reconcile CSV when done.
usage-ingest-bot: staging-replay started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/replays/replay-489123-1
Maria Gomez: +2h update: replay finished on staging; corrected delta down to 0.7%. Sending sanitized reconcile to finance and ACME.
Olivia Chan: Thanks. Partners to negotiate feed contract change; eng to add metadata-sync alert (ENG-5701); billing hold final invoice until sign-off.
